question: What is the average Healthy Life Expectancy At Birth of the world after 2020?
query: SELECT AVG(healthy_life_expectancy_at_birth) FROM world_happiness_report WHERE year > 2020 LIMIT 50;
answer: The average Healthy Life Expectancy At Birth for the world after 2020 is approximately **65.4 years**. This means that, on average, a person can expect to live about 65.4 years in good health starting from birth, based on the latest available data.
